name: Red Velvet Oat Milk Latte
caffeineNote: Label: 118 mg per can, printed above the nutrition panel
summary: Red velvet on Jolene's oat milk latte, sold as Red and read off a can in hand. The panel is topped with 118 mg of caffeine for the 8 fl oz can, the same figure the Gold prints, at 120 calories with 1 g of protein. All 10 g of its sugar is added, sweetened with organic coconut sugar, and the can carries the Fair Trade Certified mark. Made in a facility that also processes tree nuts. No price yet: we have not confirmed where Jolene sells it online.
